streamDiagnostic.shape: preStopEvaluation.streamDiagnostic = { category, code, name, chunks, abortedBeforeFirstChunk, abortedAfterFirstChunk, timedOut, message }

categories.empty-provider-stream: stream completed with zero chunks and no error
categories.timeout: deadline/ETIMEDOUT pattern or expired run deadline
categories.aborted: caller/run abort signal; before/after first chunk are separate booleans
categories.unknown: anything else; provider internals are never guessed

streamDiagnostic.bounds: short category/code/name/flag facts; message is only the controlled label `<Name>[:<CODE>]` (<=80 chars) and the provider message body is deliberately NOT retained; no prompt, response body, path or provider text
exposure: attached to the failed decision error object as streamDiagnostic + goalSessionSummary
recorded via the same bounded in-process handoff used by contextDiagnostic; CoreDomain unknown() attaches them to the unknown evaluation (streamDiagnostic, goalSessionSummary)
bounded runner preStopEvaluation.streamDiagnostic + receipt.goalSessionSummary carry them; the independent receipt validator bounds/validates both
streamDiagnostic.noAutoRetry: the instrumentation never retries; a failure/unknown outcome stays terminal. A human/owner-authorized retry is explicitly the next experimental option, never default behavior
code: src/adapters/dsh/core-decision.ts stream() instrumentation + providerStreamDiagnostic + Goal Session summary

goalSessionSummary.shape: { provider, model, reasoningEffort, maxTokens, toolCount, eventCounts, attemptStreamLengths, turnEndReasons }
goalSessionSummary.bounds: provider/model/effort labels, counts, attempt stream lengths and controlled turn/end reason codes only; event-type keys are lossless-JSON safe (non-alphanumeric replaced with _); no event body or text
goalSessionSummary.purpose: lets the next host run distinguish request/header configuration, provider attempt length (empty=0), turn/end reason and the reached request layer directly from the receipt
